title: xAI-VNS: Burden-Constrained Policy-Layer Authorization for Simulated EEG-Guided Adaptive Vagus Nerve Stimulation
description: Final resubmission analysis accompanying the manuscript on simulated EEG-guided VNS policy-layer authorization. Version v1.2.0 retains the complete 175-EDF evaluation, adds a causal decision-time sensitivity showing that the principal false-cluster endpoint is unchanged under window-end truth assignment, and adds an EDF-level chb05 diagnostic showing that the high held-out burden is distributed across recordings rather than driven by a single anomalous EDF. The release includes derived inputs, fitted models, predictions, policy/event outputs, targeted robustness outputs, tests, final figures, compiled manuscript and reviewer response, and LaTeX sources. Raw CHB-MIT EEG is not redistributed.
